title: bromus intermedius subsp. optimae
intro: Bromus intermedius subsp. optimae, commonly known as Mountain Brome, is a species of grass in the family Poaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional herbal medicine. The health benefits of Mountain Brome include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Mountain Brome include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
